purpose: Fresh scoreboard diagnostic for UNCHANGED selected executable, separate from failed role policy experiment. No role wrapper, no candidate or runtime promotion; no pooling with old series.
primary: Each of six throughput workloads must have paired median Glass/Ghostty >1 and two-sided exact sign p <.05 after Holm correction across six, with more wins than losses. Outer rounds only; alternate two launch orders, DA1 154x39, fastest of three. This criterion only licenses conditional throughput evidence, NOT every metric or championship. Fixed 30 rounds; no rescue extension.
secondary: Descriptive per-workload median Glass/Ghostty terminal CPU seconds ratios where both positive. No startup/latency/GPU/energy claim, no broad CPU superiority testing. CPU value corresponds to fastest-time sample, not independent replicate.
limitations: Same fixed workload order; best-of-three not median; shared host, no isolation, no time-block dependence guarantee; exact sign tests conditional on independent round signs. All rounds retained. This is a new series, do not select or pool favorable previous binary/series. New dataset does not overwrite prior evidence.
